title: Opioid warning label.
bodyText:
In addition to any requirements for labeling of drugs under part I of chapter 328, part III of this chapter, and any other requirement for labeling of prescription drugs pursuant to state or federal law, a health care professional or pharmacist who dispenses any opioid drug shall include on the drug's package a warning label that contains wording substantially similar to the following warning:

"Caution: Opioid. Risk of overdose and addiction."
bodyHtml:
[§329-39.5]  Opioid warning label.  In addition to any requirements for labeling of drugs under part I of chapter 328, part III of this chapter, and any other requirement for labeling of prescription drugs pursuant to state or federal law, a health care professional or pharmacist who dispenses any opioid drug shall include on the drug's package a warning label that contains wording substantially similar to the following warning:

     "Caution:  Opioid.  Risk of overdose and addiction."

[L 2018, c 151, §2]
